scope_guards: The 2025 national SuDS standards are non-statutory guidance and not a candidate approval.
Runoff destination, interception and extreme-rainfall standards remain separate.
Water-quality, amenity and biodiversity benefits are not assumed without design evidence.
LLFA consultation and EA standing advice are procedural evidence, not drainage consent.
An FRA trigger is not proof that drainage is unacceptable or acceptable.
SWIM appraisal is not funding award, construction or maintenance adoption.
Generic rainfall or catchment evidence is not an executed hydraulic model.
No score or promotion is written without exact topography, drainage design, calculations, ownership, maintenance and planning evidence.
